title: 第21章 神秘的岛主大争之世第22章 各大守护灵传人连环算计
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
呼~
停止杀戮后，赢天呼出一口浊气，随后闭眼深呼吸，说道：“自从回到家族以后，好久没有这么爽了！”
“安逸的生活，让我都快忘记这种感觉了~”
李智肩扛擂鼓翁金锤说道：“是啊~这种万军从中厮杀的感觉，实在是痛快！”
“让人上瘾啊~”
子湮看着一片狼藉的森林遗憾的说道：“唉~可惜这些恶灵太少了，还得九个人分，根本不够杀啊~”
夏尊邪邪一笑道：“嘿嘿~在这龙魂岛中，你还怕没有恶灵杀？”
“等之后安定了，多收集点龙魂岛的情报，有的是恶灵给你杀。”
“就怕到时候，你杀到手软，提不起刀，那就好玩喽~”
子湮不屑的说道：“嗤~你瞧不起谁呢？就这种货色，再来百八十万也就那样~”
赵玉抚摸着盘龙棍说道：“兄弟们，别那么暴力嘛~”
“作为皇室子弟，我们还是得以理服人才是~”
朱锐鄙视道：“切~也不知道刚才是哪个家伙杀的最欢~”
“张口仁义道德，闭口道德仁义，虚伪~”
赵玉闻言瞬间，眯着眼睛笑道：“咋地？你是想拿你的大明朱雀和我的盘龙棍碰一碰？”
朱锐不甘示弱道：“来~咱倒是要看看你的盘龙棍，有没有你的嘴皮子利索！”
杨乾看热闹不嫌事大的说道：“哈哈哈~打起来，打起来！”
“刚打完仗，就有好戏看，不错，不错~”
“赵玉别怂啊，上去钢啊~”
“朱锐给他来一剑，让他以后不敢再唠叨你~”

姬冕慢条斯理的擦了擦身上的血迹说道：“好啦~你们几个别闹了~”
“我们还是先找个地方，清理一下身上的污垢吧。”
作为队伍中年龄最大的刘枢笑道：“姬冕你这从小洁癖的毛病，还是没变啊？”
姬冕摇头淡笑道：“我这怎么能算洁癖？顶多是爱干净罢了~”
赢天将问天剑收回寄灵空间后笑道：“行了，哥几个，咱们还是先追上孔儒他们吧。”
“等先把族人们安顿好，之后的事之后再说。”
“快点，咱们几个都在这，要是他们遇到危险就不好了~”
说完，便带头向着孔儒等人撤离的方向奔去。
李智，夏尊等人互相对视一眼后，也纷纷向着赢天的方向迅速的移动。
很快九人便消失在了，这被众人毁得一片狼藉的森林之中。
而在赢天等人离开后，一棵二十多米高的巨树上，两道一老一少的人影缓缓浮。
content_en:
Phew~
After stopping the killing, Yingtian exhaled a breath, then closed his eyes and took a deep breath, and said: "I haven't felt this good for a long time since I returned to the family!"
"The comfortable life has made me almost forget this feeling~"
Li Zhi carried the drum beater's golden hammer on his shoulder and said: "Yes~ This feeling of thousands of troops fighting in it is really exciting!"
"It's addictive~"
Zi Yan looked at the messy forest and said regretfully: "Oh~ It's a pity that there are too few evil spirits. They have to be divided among nine people, which is not enough to kill~"
Xia Zun smiled evilly and said: "Hehe~ In this Dragon Soul Island, are you afraid that there will be no evil spirits to kill you?"
"When things settle down, collect more information about Dragon Soul Island. There will be many evil spirits to kill for you."
"I'm afraid that when the time comes, you'll be so weak that you can't lift the knife, so that'll be fun~"
Zi Yan said disdainfully: "Tsk~ Who are you looking down on? It's just this kind of stuff, and if it costs another 1.8 million, it will be just like that~"
Zhao Yu stroked the Panlong Stick and said, "Brothers, don't be so violent~"
"As children of the royal family, we still have to reason and convince people~"
Zhu Rui said with disdain: "Tsk~ I don't know which guy killed the most fun just now~"
"Open your mouth to be benevolent and righteous, but shut up your mouth to be moral, benevolent and righteous, hypocritical~"
The moment Zhao Yu heard this, he narrowed his eyes and smiled: "What? Do you want to touch your Ming Dynasty Vermillion Bird with my Coiling Dragon Stick?"
Not to be outdone, Zhu Rui said: "Come on, let's see if your Panlong Stick is as sharp as your tongue!"
Yang Qian was watching the excitement and said without thinking it was a big deal: "Hahaha~ Let's fight, let's fight!"
"Just after the battle, there will be a good show to watch, not bad, not bad~"
"Zhao Yu, don't be a coward, go up to the steel~"
"Zhu Rui give him a sword so that he won't dare to nag you again~"
Ji Mian slowly wiped the blood on his body and said, "Okay, you guys, stop making trouble~"
"Let's find a place to clean up the dirt first."
As the oldest member of the team, Liu Shu smiled and said, "Ji Mian, your mysophobia problem has not changed since childhood?"
Ji Mian shook his head and smiled lightly: "How can I be considered a mysophobia? At most, I just love to be clean~"
Yingtian took the Wentian Sword back to the spirit space and said with a smile: "Okay, brothers, let's catch up with Kong Ru and the others first."
“We’ll settle the clan members first, and we’ll talk about the rest later.”
"Hurry up, we are all here, it will be bad if they are in danger~"
After saying that, he took the lead and ran towards the direction where Kong Ru and others were evacuating.
After Li Zhi, Xia Zun and others looked at each other, they also moved quickly in the direction of Yingtian.
Soon the nine people disappeared into the forest that was destroyed by everyone.
After Yingtian and others left, two figures, one old and one young, slowly floated up on a giant tree more than 20 meters high.
